KUNINGRIIGID GODOT AUTOPORT — V0.80 STRATEGIC FOG-OF-WAR RELEASE

Merged source: https://github.com/orogdor/Kuningriigid-Godot-AutoPort/commit/0e7775fe6bb5cfbe6bdfc547bcec9f74c827a64b
Validation: https://github.com/orogdor/Kuningriigid-Godot-AutoPort/actions/runs/42091324887 (full GDScript, Three.js parity, soldier GLB and regression checks passed).
Android legacy bridge: https://github.com/orogdor/Kuningriigid-Godot-AutoPort/actions/runs/42091324736 (success).
Changes: GPU-cached 220x165 fog textures on 2D and 3D maps; scouting reveals territory, distant enemy warbands stay concealed until visible; fog toggle persists; migration from V79 saves.
Release policy: Publish tested Windows and PCK assets; produce APK only with the configured permanent Android signing key. Never claim a debug-signed APK is an installable update.
